claims.statement: Two independently constructed box topologies have equal controlled solid signatures but remain distinct partner groups after import.
Every subject is withheld from meshing because two independent solid bodies occupy the same geometric volume.
Every imported edge, face, and logical-region occurrence is assigned exactly once to the coincident-body topology disposition.
The assembly contains two independent solids with equal bounding, centroid, volume, face, edge, and vertex signatures at identical placements.

validation_findings.evidence: Both boxes contain only positive-length straight edges.
Every edge in both independent boxes has an exact three-dimensional line representation.
The two independent 5 by 6 by 7 millimetre solids have identical controlled signatures and placements.
All unique vertices, edges, and faces retain the same 1e-7 millimetre imported tolerance.
Each independent box has one closed outer shell.
Both independent box B-reps are valid even though their occupied volumes coincide.

oracle.statement: Two separate 5 by 6 by 7 millimetre boxes are added as independent simple-shape definitions at the identity placement. Each contributes one solid, one shell, six faces, twelve edges, and eight vertices. Equality of their independently derived volume and topological signature proves one coincident-solid pair without conflating their partner identities.
